name: jinjer
description: Jinja2 Previewer - Now with more features!

jinjer.contextFile.description: The name of the context file (JSON or YAML) to use for rendering Jinja templates.  If the file is not found in the same directory as the template, parent directories will be searched until the file is found or the workspace root is reached (similar to .gitignore).

jinjer.variableSuffix.description: If set (e.g., "suffix"), the context data will be wrapped under this key. For example, with variableSuffix = "suffix", a template using {{ suffix.variable }} will render using the value from the context file key "variable".

jinjer.settingsFile.description: The name of the per-workspace settings file (JSON). This file allows to override global Jinjer settings on a per-workspace basis.

jinjer.contextIncludeKey.description: The key in context files (JSON/YAML) that specifies an array of other context file paths to include and merge. Paths are relative to the file containing this key. Set to null or empty string to disable. This VS Code setting can be overridden for a specific workspace by defining `contextIncludeKey` (using the same value types) in the `.jinjer-settings.json` file.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
